name: Thule Urban Glide Car Seat Adapter for Maxi-Cosi
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / BeSafe / Cybex / Nuna (Maxi-Cosi-style footprint). Clek's official list confirms the Clek Liing/Liingo attaches to the Urban Glide 2 via THIS adapter (20110740) — the Liing uses the Maxi-Cosi footprint.
_statusNote: Superseded on Thule DTC by the Urban Glide 3 adapters (20110761 Maxi-Cosi / 20110762 universal). Listed 'No Longer Available' at Pottery Barn Kids; limited/legacy stock at Rack Attack, Bicycle Buys, eTrailer. Original MSRP $69.95.

install.notes: Click-in car seat mounting; fits Thule Urban Glide 2, Urban Glide 2 Double, and Glide 2 frames.

notes: The Urban Glide 2's Maxi-Cosi car seat adapter (MSRP $69.95), now largely discontinued with the UG2 stroller itself; buy legacy/limited stock only. NOTE: covered by the same March 2020 Thule Sleek/Urban Glide/Glide car-seat-adapter recall (car seat could detach) — confirm a remedied unit. Newer Urban Glide 3/4 use the universal 20110762 instead (adapter-20110762).
